code.extract_of: airq_live_tick.py, the live panel of PLAN.md Addenda 2 and 3: the sensor pick from data/pairs.json, metrics, meets, corrected, ab_ok and outcome as written, and the rolling evaluation over the last 60 UTC days the tick read, which end on the newest AirNow day it kept

name: AIRQ
sources: AirNow real-time hourly files, https://files.airnowtech.org/airnow/YYYY/YYYYMMDD/HourlyData_YYYYMMDDHH.dat, PM2.5 lines of the panel monitors. data/live_days.json (ref) keeps the daily mean of each monitor, from 18 or more hours.

PurpleAir daily history of the sensor picked for each monitor, https://api.purpleair.com/v1/sensors/ID/history with average=1440. data/live_days.json (sens) keeps the atm and cf_1 channels and humidity of each day. A PurpleAir read needs a PurpleAir key.
data/pairs.json is the sensor and monitor pairing of the main read (1 March to 30 June 2026), from which the live panel takes the median-RMSE sensor of each monitor.
why_not_included: its inputs are the AirNow and PurpleAir daily values the live tick read, and a PurpleAir read needs a PurpleAir key. Each input is named with its sha256
